site.name: Bird Nest and Village Belle Mine
overview: Bird Nest and Village Belle Mine is a named historic mine feature south of Eldora in western Boulder County, preserved on U.S. Geological Survey Nederland-area topographic mapping.
moreHistory: USGS-derived mapping places the named Bird Nest and Village Belle Mine near Spencer Mountain at approximately 39.944987, -105.572778. Available sources support the mine-level location and identity but do not establish a detailed operating chronology or a field-verified surviving opening.
